run.name: Caci International Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (CACI)
run.summary: CACI has a sound but more leveraged credit profile, supported by a federally funded revenue base, ample liquidity and solid cash flow. Leverage after the March 2026 acquisition is the weak point, and covenant and guarantor terms are unverified. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is CACI INTERNATIONAL INC /DE/.

revenue.basis: Revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Management EBITDA, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal debt 4,864.438 over LTM EBITDA 1,234.129 (FY2026 plus Q1 FY2027 less Q1 FY2026); cash 279.389. Same part-year acquisition contribution; not pro forma; not a covenant ratio.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Management EBITDA 1,173.914 over cash paid for interest 213.640. Acquisition debt outstanding only from March 2026, so cash interest does not yet show a full year of it.

cash.basis: Cash. Undrawn capacity as printed in the Q1 FY2027 filing; revolver drawn 605.000. Cash includes pound sterling and euro balances of 92.7 not immediately available to U.S. operations. Receivable sale capacity (maximum 350.0) is almost fully used and is excluded. Revolver matures November 2030.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, guarantors, ownership and acquired-business earnings are not supplied, so leverage cannot be tested against covenants or on a run-rate basis.

CP-1 main limitation: Management EBITDA is the only earnings measure; covenant levels, definitions and a pro forma acquisition view are not supplied, so leverage is not on a covenant or run-rate basis.
